messages:
maya patel: quick heads-up 1: deploying route-safeguard v2 to canary in the quiet window. We'll use feature flag `route.safeguard_v2` with a staggered ramp and a fast-pin on rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (id db-1808). Canary replicas: 4. Healthchecks and auto-slo enabled.

sam wilson: Proposed ramp: 1% -> 6% @10m -> 22% @30m -> 55% @75m (manual hold) -> 100% after 2h stable. Rollback rules: global error_rate >0.6% OR p95 delta >130ms -> immediate rollback and pin. Regional spike >0.9% for >2m -> partial drain to previous step.

jordan lee: note: expect KV-cache warmup causing a short p95 bump for ~3-5m. We'll ignore p95 spikes shorter than 3m immediately after each step. Also prepping fast-pin curl snippet.

ops-bot: Manual holdpoint configured at 55%. Oncall will be notified. Auto-pin action configured to pin to `route-safeguard_v1` with ttl=1800s on rollback.

maya patel: adding a tracing sampling bump during the first 10m post-55% to help triage.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 1%. Healthchecks passing 4/4.

sam wilson: moved to 6% after +9m: p95 +22ms, errors steady. advancing to 22% per schedule.

jordan lee: 22% reached. traces look OK. oncall monitor is green.

ops-bot: Reached 55% holdpoint. Oncall paged for approval.

sam wilson: approving continue to 100% unless oncall flags anything within 30m.

jordan lee: small regional blip in us-west at +8m (0.95% for ~130s). below 2m threshold so no auto partial drain. keeping an eye.

ops-bot: No auto-rollback triggered. Manual hold cleared to continue ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% scheduled after soak.

sam wilson: final: 100% live. release notes: "route-safeguard v2 rolled via staggered FF ramp; fast-pin on rollback configured; warmup guidance and tracing bump included."

maya patel: thanks team. I'll open a retro to revisit the ignore-window and regional thresholds. :tada:
